long_biography.plain_text:
Oldendorff spent his twenties gaining practical experience in container services at Maersk, shipbuilding projects at Aker and dry-bulk operations at Bocimar. He also completed a master's in shipping, trade and finance at London's Cass Business School. After family ownership of Reederei Nord passed to Christian and his twin brother, Nikolaus, day-to-day management remained largely with Nikolaus and professional executives.

Christian developed a parallel investment career. He created Oldendorff Overseas Investments to connect institutional capital with shipping assets, then launched Berlin-based Amplifier in 2016. The venture platform focuses on early-stage maritime, logistics and mobility technology, including artificial intelligence, robotics and decarbonization. He remains a Reederei Nord co-owner while concentrating publicly on venture investing and supply-chain innovation.
